assertions.description: DOMParser parses a well-formed XML document into an XML DOM — the observable contract that must hold identically on the C++ and Rust engines (scenario 1 of the chromestatus summary).
DOMParser surfaces a parsererror element for malformed (non-well-formed) XML — it must never throw and never silently repair.
Namespaced XML is parsed with namespace URIs, prefixes, and local names intact.
The five predefined entities and numeric character references decode during parsing: '&' + '©' yield '&' + U+00A9 in textContent.
A CDATA section parses to a CDATASection node (nodeType 4) whose contents stay literal — '<' and '&' inside it are not markup.
assertions.test: (()=>{const d=new DOMParser().parseFromString('<t><![CDATA[a < b & c]]></t>','application/xml');const n=d.documentElement.firstChild;return n.nodeType===4&&n.nodeValue==='a < b & c';})()

assertions.description: XMLHttpRequest with responseType 'document' parses an XML response into a real Document (scenario 2 of the chromestatus summary — a Rust-parsed path once the switch lands).
A standalone SVG document loads as an external image resource with its intrinsic size (scenarios 3-4 of the chromestatus summary — SVG image paths the Rust parser takes over).
assertions.test: (()=>new Promise((resolve)=>{const img=new Image();img.onload=()=>resolve(img.naturalWidth===24&&img.naturalHeight===24);img.onerror=()=>resolve(false);img.src='data:image/svg+xml,'+encodeURIComponent('<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24"><rect width="24" height="24"/></svg>');setTimeout(()=>resolve(false),3000);}))()
